title: Audit the CUJ portfolio and emit a strict automated-proof ledger
createdBy: codex after the chairman requested cross-project CUJ truth and durable automated proofs

historicalContent.description: Make CUJ-25 audit active-owned project and definition truth across the portfolio, make CUJ-26 emit one canonical proof ledger, reject unsupported proven claims, and carry the resulting evidence through the Vaporize release spine.
acceptanceCriteria: CUJ-25 distinguishes active-owned implementation roots from dependency checkouts and reports typed, legacy, bound, executable, evidence-backed, and proven counts.
CUJ-26 emits one saved ledger that separates missing-binding, binding-only, executable-bound, evidence-backed, and strict proven states.
A strict proven claim requires a binding, an executable test, a saved green receipt, and a chronon.
Automation never substitutes for a required human approval.
The full Vaporize suite, schema suite, release doctor, and JSON validation remain green.
